name: SI1145 UV index / IR / visible light

pins.name: 3VO
pins.notes: 3.3 V output of the on-board regulator. Leave unconnected

pins.name: LED
pins.notes: For an external IR LED (proximity). Leave unconnected

sources.title: Silicon Labs Si1145/46/47 datasheet
sources.section: Register 0x00 PART_ID (0x45 = Si1145, 0x46 = Si1146, 0x47 = Si1147); I2C address 0x60

sources.title: Silicon Labs Si1145/46/47 datasheet
sources.section: UV index is calculated from visible and IR light, it has no real UV photodiode
